headline: Houthi Attack on Saudi Oil Refinery Pushes Oil Prices Higher
summary: Attacks by Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura oil refinery pushed oil prices up, highlighting regional vulnerabilities.
why: Crude oil supply disruptions in major exporting nations directly influence global energy costs, transportation expenses, and headline inflation metrics worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Physical attacks on major Saudi refinery infrastructure restrict regional oil supply, driving upward pressure on global crude benchmarks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Attacks on key refining infrastructure in Saudi Arabia restrict supply flows from a major exporter, directly driving up global oil prices.
